review_notes: I read the whole file and compared it with Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Basic.lean and ModuleCat/Ulift.lean. I also grepped for FGModuleCat uses. The wrappers isoToLinearEquiv, LinearEquiv.toFGModuleCatIso, of/ofHom and the Iso.conj lemmas build on existing ModuleCat API. They are named specialisations or theorem-level overlap, so I did not report them. The only real parallel is the universe-lift functor. I did not check whether Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Ulift can be imported here without creating an import cycle, though I saw no sign of one. I also did not check how well the restricted functor would unfold in downstream proofs such as EssentiallySmall.lean.

findings.problem: Mathlib already has the universe-lift functor on modules, `ModuleCat.uliftFunctor`. It has the same object part (`ULift X`), the same map formula (conjugating by `ULift.moduleEquiv`), and the same fully-faithful structure (`ModuleCat.fullyFaithfulUliftFunctor`). `FGModuleCat.ulift` and `fullyFaithfulULift` copy that definition and proof for the full subcategory. They only add the finiteness proof, which `ObjectProperty` machinery could supply. As a result the two functors are not tied together by any lemma or definitional link. Any further API for the lift, such as exactness, additivity or the compatibility with `forget`, would have to be duplicated or reproved. The file also never states that the FG version is a restriction of the ModuleCat one.
findings.proposed_change: Define `FGModuleCat.ulift` as the restriction of `ModuleCat.uliftFunctor R` to the full subcategory, using the `ObjectProperty` lift/`lift` construction. The finiteness proof for `ULift M` would be the existing `Module.Finite` instance on `ULift`. Derive `fullyFaithfulULift` from `ModuleCat.fullyFaithfulUliftFunctor`, for example by showing that the forget₂ composite is `ModuleCat.uliftFunctor`. Keep the name `FGModuleCat.ulift` and its `Full`/`Faithful` instances for existing users. Add a `ulift ⋙ forget₂ ≅ forget₂ ⋙ ModuleCat.uliftFunctor` iso (or a rfl-lemma) so the two stay linked.
findings.benefit: Removes a second copy of the lift construction and its fully-faithful proof. It also makes the FG lift definitionally and API-compatible with the ModuleCat lift, so existing lemmas (additivity, exactness, preservation of limits and projectives) can be reused instead of reproved. Readers can then see that it is the same functor.
